headline: Fine flower-color states retain phylogenetic organization inside coarse color states in most opportunity clades: 18/21 permutation-centered conditional AUC effects are positive, with median +0.0270 AUC.
interpretation: Global coarse-versus-fine winner status hides nested organization. Fine-state phylogenetic memory can persist within a coarse phenotype even when the global profile tilts toward coarse resolution.
claim_boundary: permutation-centering is required because the conditional null AUC need not equal 0.5
hidden fine memory is distinct from global scale tilt and overall memory amplitude
not independent replication of the source data
